Candlelit gothic library — foreground mahogany writing-desk spills amber wax-light across open ledgers, a cracked inkwell, and a bundle of letters sealed with black wax impressed with a moth; mid-frame dark-oak bookcases climb floor to distant ceiling, their leather spines cracked and gilt-titled and pressed together with no breath between them; deep beyond a carved archway a velvet wing-chair crouches beside a smoldering fireplace, a half-open book splayed face-down on its arm as though the reader vanished mid-page.

Scrying-chamber alcove — foreground a velvet-draped table bears a fogged crystal orb pooling a faint interior luminescence, ringed by four taper candles dripping wax into curling puddles on the cloth; scattered tarot cards fan at the table's edge, the topmost showing a crowned figure reversed; mid-ground carved oak ceiling beams suspend a brass astrolabe and a long copper pendulum still in the airless room; deeper, a tarnished obsidian-framed mirror leans against the far wall, its surface clouded, reflecting nothing faithful.

Alchemy laboratory shelf — close frame on a stone-slab workbench where a copper alembic crouches over a spirit-lamp's small orange tongue, coiled glass tubing threading heat from vessel to vessel in amber loops; mid-ground a cluttered iron rack holds brass retorts, earthenware jars labeled in cramped Latin, and a cracked mortar stained violet with pigment residue; deeper shadow hides shelves packed with leather-bound treatises, a snuffed forge breathing its last orange warmth into the stone below.

Curio-cabinet wonder-room — foreground a tall glass case lit by a single oil-lamp cradles an articulated fox skull alongside a nautilus shell and a mineral specimen glittering rose-gold in the low light; mid-ground open shelves display taxidermied beetles under hand-blown bell-jars and pinned moths pressed behind dusty frame-glass in shadow-boxes; deeper darkness opens onto a wall of brass theodolites, astral compasses, and phrenology busts above a carved oak desk littered with half-rolled vellum sketches.

Gothic study — foreground a broad escritoire sits close under a green-glass oil-lamp whose warm pool falls across a manuscript page mid-sentence, a raven quill abandoned in a puddle of dried ink; mid-frame crammed bookshelves flank a stone chimney-breast hung with a mounted antlered skull and a framed celestial chart; deep corner shadows conceal a leather chesterfield draped in a wool throw, a low table beside it holding a glass of dark liquid and an open book of verse.

Mourning-parlor — foreground a narrow console table draped in black velvet holds a cluster of memorial photographs in ebony frames, faces pale and formal against dark studio grounds, a small braided hair-wreath under a glass dome beside them; mid-room heavy black moiré drapes fall floor-to-ceiling, swallowing the windows entirely; deep against the far wall a fireplace burns low, its mantel crowded with jet-bead jewelry on velvet stands and a single oil portrait of a woman whose eyes follow the room.

Occult parlor — foreground a wide plank floor shows a chalked sigil in careful geometric arcs, a brass ritual brazier at its center breathing sandalwood smoke upward; mid-room folded tapestries printed with planetary symbols and cabalistic diagrams hang dense from iron rods, overlapping at the edges; deeper a false bookcase stands ajar on its hinge, the gap behind it breathing cold air, its interior shelves visible and packed with locked leatherbound volumes whose spines bear no titles.

Dark-academy reading nook — foreground a plum velvet armchair pressed close to a leaded casement window where amber candlelight catches every lead line and bubbled pane, a tower of read-and-returned tomes stacked on the floor beside the chair's claw foot; mid-frame a Persian rug in garnet and black anchors the nook against the stone flags; deeper a hearth burns steadily, its mantelpiece holding inkpots, a letter opener, a brass magnifying glass, and a crow's feather curled at the lip.

Witch's apothecary corner — foreground a low stool holds a wide ceramic bowl dusted with dried chamomile and a folded square of linen stained faintly with oil; mid-shelf a long pine dresser runs the full wall, its every surface loaded with cork-stopped phials, hand-written paper labels peeling at the corners, dried mushroom caps, and coils of twine; deeper the corner darkens under braided bundles of rosemary and foxglove hanging from a beam, a witch-ball of green glass turning slowly in a draft with no apparent source.

Alchemy laboratory workshop — foreground a slate-topped bench holds a cooling crucible beside a brass balance and an open notebook whose pages are covered in diagrams of retort configurations and margin-notes in a cramped hand; mid-frame a wooden rack rises with shelves of pigment jars — cobalt, vermillion, bone-white — and coiled copper piping hooked on iron pegs; deep a snuffed forge glows faintly in its stone cradle, heating the air above it into a shimmer that warps the shadow-bound shelves of treatises behind.

Scrying-divination chamber — foreground a round table covered in indigo silk holds a deck of hand-painted tarot face-down, a single reversed card placed on top beside a pool of dark mirror-glass set in a pewter tray; mid-ground iron candelabra rise on either side, their candles burning unevenly, wax cascading in long stalactites down the arms; deeper a carved wooden cabinet stands open, its interior shelves packed with silk-wrapped orbs, a pendulum on a chain, and jars of charged water sealed with red thread.

Candlelit gothic library — foreground a reading stand holds an enormous open folio, its illuminated margins gilded and dark with age, a magnifying glass resting on the vellum beside a burnt-down taper in a brass holder; mid-frame floor-to-ceiling shelves of dark-spined volumes press inward from both walls, a rolling library ladder leaning at a crooked angle; deeper a lancet window of leaded glass filters no light, only reflects back the amber candle glow, and beneath it a secretary desk spills wax-sealed correspondence.

Séance chamber — foreground a round pedestal table draped in black damask holds eight white taper candles in a ring, one snuffed, its smoke still rising; mid-room high-backed chairs with carved finials crowd the table, their red velvet seats worn at the center; deeper a sideboard against the far wall carries framed cabinet photographs, a ceramic urn draped in jet beads, and a large oil portrait in a gilded frame whose varnish has darkened the subject almost to silhouette.

Gothic greenhouse conservatory interior — foreground a stone trough near the entrance bursts with carnivorous plants — pitcher plants, a Venus flytrap in a clay pot, sundews glistening on wire — lit by a gas-lamp's low blue-gold flame; mid-frame twisted iron staging holds mossy pots trailing vines that have crept into the overhead glazing bars; deep at the room's far end a wrought-iron chair sits overgrown at its legs, a trowel resting across its arm, and darkness pools in the corners where the vine has eaten the lamp.
